$comment: Machine-readable brand lock for scripts/brand-check.mjs and scripts/inspect.sh. Keep in sync with design/BRAND.md. Example values: replace all of them.
$referenceId: Must match one of the 15 referenceId values in references/design-archetypes.md §1 (editorial-portal, kinetic-wordmark, daylight-atelier, chromatic-collage, obsidian-canvas, alpine-swiss, reactive-timeline, gallery-filmstrip, stone-wipe, blueprint-rails, archival-viewfinder, linen-editorial, chiaroscuro-stage, modular-chapters, cutup-exhibition)
$surface: Page surface class for inspect.sh: experience (default, campaign/portfolio/hospitality), persuade (SaaS/business/e-commerce), operate (app/dashboard), read (docs/blog)

fonts.$comment: allowed = every face the site may render. locked = faces the brand already owns (imported); they are exempt from the overused-font warning.

$allow: Rules the brand deliberately keeps (see DESIGN.md §7 for the reason). Applies to brand-check.mjs; inspect.allow applies to inspect.sh.
